text: In the Wellington suburb of Hataitai, meek Lionel Cosgrove lives with his domineering mother Vera in a Victorian mansion and [falls for Paquita, a shopkeeper's daughter|trigger|love and desire]. Spying on their date at the zoo, Vera is [bitten by a Sumatran rat-monkey|images|monsters and hybrid creatures] smuggled from Skull Island, and she dies and rises hungry. Lionel hides her in the basement with tranquillisers, but [every bite makes another zombie|rules|it passes to others], until a nurse, a priest and a whole party of guests [crowd the house of his smothering mother|wants|keeping people forever].
